name: legacy-bridge-terminal
description: Unified macro + correlation terminal over Refinitiv and market data. Static frontend, optional Supabase backend.

scripts.ingest:us: python macro/scripts/extract_observations.py --country us && python macro/scripts/extract_rics.py --country us
scripts.ingest:id: python macro/scripts/extract_observations.py --country id && python macro/scripts/extract_rics.py --country id
scripts.ingest:cn: python macro/scripts/extract_observations.py --country cn && python macro/scripts/extract_rics.py --country cn
scripts.graph: python macro/scripts/build_graph.py --country us && python macro/scripts/build_graph.py --country id && python macro/scripts/build_graph.py --country cn
